_source: Trimmed from Google's Discovery document cloudbilling v1beta, revision 20261009: only the methods the curated tools call (cloudbilling.billingAccounts.skus.price.get, cloudbilling.skus.price.get) and the schemas their request bodies reach. For tests/curated-contract.test.mjs; this API has no per-method tools, so data/discovery has no snapshot of it.
name: cloudbilling
title: Cloud Billing API

get.description: Gets the latest price for SKUs available to your Cloud Billing account.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required. Name of the billing account price to retrieve. Format: billingAccounts/{billing_account}/skus/{sku}/price

parameters.name: currencyCode
parameters.description: Optional. ISO-4217 currency code for the price. If not specified, the currency of the billing account is used.

get.description: Gets the latest price for the given SKU.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required. Name of the latest price to retrieve. Format: skus/{sku}/price

parameters.name: currencyCode
parameters.description: Optional. ISO-4217 currency code for the price. If not specified, USD will be used.
